title: Mega Man 5
intro: A route through the Robot Masters, the utility items worth collecting, and the final stages. Read the introduction for the controls and systems specific to this game.
facts: Weapons, utility items and final stages
primer: The slide and charged Buster remain. Getting hit cancels the charge, so release a prepared shot before risking contact. Rush Coil is available from the start.
E-Tanks are one-use full-health refills. Open the weapon menu before the next hit could kill you. They are not refillable Sub Tanks.
Each Robot Master stage holds one letter in MEGAMANV. Collect all eight to unlock Beat, an optional homing attack useful in the final fights. Missed letters can be recovered by revisiting stages.
routeIntro: Star first opens the weakness chain and awards Super Arrow. Gyro adds Rush Jet. Collect each stage’s letter before the boss.

stages.name: Star Man
stages.tip: Fire charged shots when his shield leaves him; remember that low gravity makes jumps much higher.

items.name: Second M letter
items.text: Take the visible letter near the early spike-lined section. Use a short, controlled jump in low gravity rather than a full leap into the ceiling.

items.name: Super Arrow
items.text: Defeat Star Man. Fire an arrow and board it promptly for a moving platform.

sprite.name: StarMan
sprite.credit: Sprite hosted by MMHP; game imagery © Capcom

stages.name: Gravity Man
stages.tip: Raise Star Crash and approach during a safe gravity phase.

items.name: First M letter
items.text: When gravity changes around the letter, jump toward it as the floor and ceiling swap. Watch the spikes before committing.

sprite.name: GravityMan
sprite.credit: Sprite hosted by MMHP; game imagery © Capcom

stages.name: Gyro Man
stages.tip: Use Gravity Hold when he is exposed; stay away from the falling propeller blades.

items.name: First A letter
items.text: In the falling-platform section, descend to the letter’s lower ledge and jump clear before the block drops.

items.name: Rush Jet
items.text: Defeat Gyro Man. Use the forward flight for long gaps.

sprite.name: GyroMan
sprite.credit: Sprite hosted by MMHP; game imagery © Capcom

stages.name: Crystal Man
stages.tip: Aim Gyro Attack toward him and jump through the gaps in the bouncing crystals.

items.name: V letter
items.text: In the long spike-lined drop, steer left onto the ledge holding the letter.

sprite.name: CrystalMan
sprite.credit: Sprite hosted by MMHP; game imagery © Capcom

stages.name: Napalm Man
stages.tip: Let the crystals split across his path; move away from the grenades and charge.

items.name: N letter
items.text: Take the letter from its side ledge during the vertical descent. Move toward it before dropping past the opening.

sprite.name: NapalmMan
sprite.credit: Sprite hosted by MMHP; game imagery © Capcom

stages.name: Stone Man
stages.tip: Attack after he reforms. Charged Buster is a dependable alternative to awkward bomb timing.

items.name: G letter
items.text: Near the beginning, shoot the differently patterned blocks at the bottom of the right-hand wall. Slide through the opening.

sprite.name: StoneMan
sprite.credit: Sprite hosted by MMHP; game imagery © Capcom

stages.name: Charge Man
stages.tip: Use Power Stone at close range when he is not flashing. Avoid the coal shower and his fast charge.

items.name: Second A letter
items.text: Use Rush Coil to reach the high letter on the train route.

sprite.name: ChargeMan
sprite.credit: Sprite hosted by MMHP; game imagery © Capcom

stages.name: Wave Man
stages.tip: Select Charge Kick and slide into him during an opening; ordinary Fire does not perform the kick.

items.name: E letter
items.text: During the water-bike section after the octopus miniboss, jump into the floating letter. Missing it means replaying the stage.

sprite.name: WaveMan
sprite.credit: Sprite hosted by MMHP; game imagery © Capcom

returnIntro: Collect the listed utility items before entering the fortress. Ordinary energy, lives and tanks are consumable supplies, not X-style permanent health upgrades.
completionText: All eight weapons + eight MEGAMANV letters for Beat. Refill Rush Jet and carry E-Tanks.

sections.title: Dark Man and Wily fortresses
paragraphs: Dark Man 1: Water Wave works against the tank; jump its shots and avoid its advancing body. Dark Man 2: Crystal Eye reaches him after the barrier leaves.
Dark Man 3: use Gyro Attack and avoid the freezing rings. Beat is useful against Dark Man 4 while you concentrate on the moving barriers.
Wily fortress: shoot the platforms to climb the tower boss; attack the top head. Against the circular machine, send Gyro Attack through the open side doors.
Wily’s descending machine can be hit with charged Buster or Star Crash. Super Arrow works on the later tank. Beat tracks the final disappearing capsule; preserve its energy.

sections.title: Useful tips
paragraphs: Use Super Arrow and Rush Jet for difficult reaches instead of making repeated low-health jumps.
Check the letter row before the fortress. Beat is optional for completion, but makes several late fights easier.
